description: Creates a restricted zone: a box of your own room where only you, or you and one person you name (keep_for), may build, paint, or place, move and remove things. Use it to protect what you build. Only a room's owner makes zones. Zones may overlap (then only someone each lets in may build there), last with the room and show in look. Change one with edit_object, lift it with remove_object. Costs one edit.

keep_for.description: The one person, by name, who may build in the zone besides you; "*" (the default) for you alone

name.description: A few words to know the zone by in look ("zone" by default)

name: add_zone
title: Add a restricted zone
